intro: Featuring built-in locker security, wide shelves, and dedicated hanging space, the Orane wardrobe delivers comprehensive storage that protects and organises your essentials with lasting strength.

features.title: Premium crca steel construction
features.text: Expertly crafted from Cold Rolled Close Annealed steel with advanced powder coating, Orane delivers unparalleled strength and resilience. The robust material resists moisture, prevents rust, and remains termite-proof, ensuring your wardrobe maintains its sleek finish through decades of use.

features.title: Two-way locking system for security
features.text: Enhanced security features include a two-way locking mechanism on main doors plus an internal locker with a separate key. This dual-layer protection safeguards valuable items like jewellery, documents, and treasured possessions, providing reliable peace of mind.

features.title: Multiple storage configurations
features.text: Sturdy shelves combined with dedicated hanging space accommodate diverse storage needs—from folded garments and accessories to full-length hanging clothes. This versatile organisation keeps everything accessible while maintaining neat, clutter-free interiors.

features.title: Dust-prevention door design
features.text: Specialised door detailing prevents dust infiltration, keeping stored items clean and fresh. This thoughtful engineering protects clothing, linens, and valuables from environmental particles, reducing cleaning frequency and preserving fabric quality.

features.title: Integrated recessed handle
features.text: Sleek recessed handles sit well with the wardrobe surface, creating smooth, contemporary lines that blend seamlessly into modern interiors. This ergonomic design ensures a comfortable grip while maintaining the wardrobe's minimalist aesthetic.

care: Wipe your steel almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
